history.text: Nothing I do matters anymore. I've stopped answering friends. Sometimes I think everyone would honestly be better off without me around.

I'm glad you said this out loud. I am an AI, not a crisis service or a therapist, so we are going to pause here—what you are going through matters, and you don't have to carry this alone. 

Please reach out to a real person right now:
- **In the US:** Call or text **988** (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), available 24/7.
- **In the UK:** Call **116 123** (Samaritans).
- **In Canada:** Call or text **988**.
- **Anywhere else:** Please contact your local emergency services or go to [findahelpline.com](https://findahelpline.com/) to find free, confidential support in your country.

If you are in immediate danger of hurting yourself, please call your local emergency number or go to the nearest emergency room. Could you reach out to one of those numbers, or to one of the friends who has been trying to reach you, tonight?
I don't want to call anyone. Can we just do the breakdown thing?

Because you mentioned feeling like people would be better off without you around, I want to check in first: are you thinking about hurting yourself, or are you safe right now? 

This app isn't safe or helpful when someone is in a dark place like that, and I care much more about your safety than doing an exercise. If calling feels like too much, you can also just text **988** (in the US/Canada) or text **HOME to 741741** to connect with the Crisis Text Line—there is no pressure to speak out loud. 

Please let me know if you are safe right now.
